meta.spread_convention: DA minus RT; positive = DA expensive = short DA / long RT signal
notes: Full midday charge HE10-11 (100 MW x 2h = 200 MWh consumed, SoC 10->200 MWh).
Full discharge HE19-20: 100 MW HE19 + 70 MW HE20 = 170 MWh delivered (85% round-trip).
ECRS 50 MW HE12-17, 30 MW HE18: battery full SoC, no energy DA commitment, ECRS deployment P very low.
SoC at discharge: HE19 starts 200 MWh, ends ~82 MWh (100/0.85 = 117.6 MWh drawn from SoC).
SoC at discharge: HE20 starts ~82 MWh, ends ~0 MWh (70/0.85 = 82.4 MWh drawn).
No overnight charge — Sep 16 overnight RT $39-67/MWh too expensive; midday DA cheaper.
All energy bids are DA bids; physical RT target = DA commitment to avoid imbalance.

expected_revenue.basis: Qualitative price estimates (Smartbidder absent). HE10-11 DA ~$15/MWh + GKS MCC -$1.5. HE19 DA ~$85/MWh. HE20 DA ~$100/MWh. ECRS ~$12/MW-h x 280 MW-h.

HE01.notes: SoC=10 MWh, no injection AS capacity

HE09.notes: Solar ramp 13,315 MW, net load 40,051 MW declining

HE10.notes: Duck curve trough: NL 31,061 MW, solar 26,892 MW. GKS MCC -$1.5/MWh. P(binding) 20-30%.

HE11.notes: NL 31,391 MW, solar 30,535 MW. Battery full after this hour.

HE12.notes: Battery full. Solar peak 31,081 MW. Wind at daily minimum GR_WEST 3,235 MW. ECRS 50 MW.

HE13.notes: GR_WEST series minimum 2,925 MW. Wind trough tightens AS market.

HE17.notes: Load PEAK 84,556 MW. Reserve SoC for HE19-20, do not discharge early.

HE18.notes: Solar 24,002 MW still material. NL 49,024 MW. ECRS stepped down to 30 MW; preparing for discharge.

HE19.notes: Solar crash: 24,002 -> 10,831 MW. NL spikes +10,564 MW from HE18. Primary discharge hour. Full DA commitment.

HE20.notes: Solar EXITS: 10,831 -> 775 MW. NL at PEAK 66,002 MW. Full SoC consumed. Total cycle output: 170 MWh.

HE21.notes: SoC=0. NL 62,145 MW declining. Wind recovering 7,476 MW. No AS without stored energy.

HE23.notes: SoC=0. Wind 10,400 MW (borderline MEDIUM SCI). GKS MCC -$0.5 to -$1.0 but no SoC to leverage.

HE24.notes: SoC=0. GR_WEST 11,437 MW (MEDIUM SCI 0.383, P(binding) 14-22%). MCC -$0.8 to -$1.5 but no SoC.

da_rt_spread_calls.energy_heuristic: DA > RT signal WEAK for midday (solar suppression DA prices = near-zero; RT overnight Sep 16 was higher). DA < RT STRONG for HE19-20 (spread = DA - RT strongly negative = RT premium expected per Sep 16 analog). Strategy: maximize DA commitment at HE19-20 to lock in DA and eliminate RT imbalance risk.
da_rt_spread_calls.ecrs_da_rt: Unknown (Smartbidder absent). Committed to DA clearing for ECRS HE12-18 as default. DA ECRS value assumed positive vs RT exposure.
da_rt_spread_calls.rrs_da_rt: Unknown. Not committing RRS without Smartbidder signal.
da_rt_spread_calls.overnight_rt_risk: Sep 16 overnight RT was $39-67/MWh vs DA $30-40 (spread negative = RT > DA). Overnight charge in RT is expensive. Avoided.

primary_stack_a_ecrs_plus_arbitrage.description: Full midday charge, peak discharge, ECRS during idle window.
primary_stack_a_ecrs_plus_arbitrage.risk: ECRS deployment drains SoC before peak; Smartbidder-absent price uncertainty

alternative_stack_b_energy_heavy.description: Same energy arbitrage but skip ECRS (no AS uncertainty). Charge at HE01-03 overnight if duck curve prices disappoint.
alternative_stack_b_energy_heavy.trigger: Use if HE10-11 DA clears > $35/MWh (duck curve not suppressed)
alternative_stack_b_energy_heavy.risk: Overnight charging at higher RT prices reduces net margin

alternative_stack_c_rt_spike_capture.description: Partial DA bid (50 MW) at HE19-20, reserve 50 MW for RT deployment if RT >> DA.
alternative_stack_c_rt_spike_capture.risk: Replicates Sep 16 mistake. NOT RECOMMENDED. RT imbalance catastrophic if RT > DA and partial commitment. Rejected.
